title: rhodanthemum maroccanum
intro: Rhodanthemum maroccanum, commonly known as Moroccan Chamomile, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae) native to North Africa. This herb is valued for its calming and soothing properties, offering potential health benefits such as reducing anxiety and promoting better sleep. The therapeutic actions of Rhodanthemum maroccanum are attributed to its sedative and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of insomnia, restlessness, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include apigenin, a flavonoid known for its antioxidant and anti-anxiety properties.
